attributes.powers: Display this card next to a location. While displayed, characters at that location add 1d6 and the Poison trait to their combat checks. At the end of the turn, each character at that location is dealt 1 Poison damage, then if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 8 check to recharge it instead.
